user.title: Connect to Traefik
user.description: Enter the base address of the Traefik API. That is the host and port the dashboard is served on — the integration appends the API paths itself.

data_description.username: Only needed if the API is behind basic authentication.
data_description.password: Only needed if the API is behind basic authentication.
data_description.metrics_url: Optional. Traefik usually serves /metrics on its own entry point. Without it, the connection, reload and certificate expiry sensors stay unavailable.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Traefik
reauth_confirm.description: Traefik at {url} is refusing the current credentials.

error.invalid_auth: Access denied. The API may be behind basic authentication, or an IP allow list that does not include Home Assistant.
error.invalid_response: Traefik answered, but not with an API response. Check that the API is enabled and that the address points at the API entry point.

abort.already_configured: This Traefik instance is already configured

init.title: Tracked routers
init.description: Pick the routers you want their own device and entities for. Everything else is still counted by the instance sensors.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach Traefik to list its routers
